Entry.Message: Target down. Log the location so we can come back to scan it.
It's going down! Leave a beacon incase there are surviors.
Splash one. Command, we'll need to circle back to scan the area.
Contact neutralized. Ensure the area is secure before moving on.
All threats neutralized. Proceed with caution and continue the survey.
Hostile contact fell with allied help.
Appreciate the support, now let us scan these remains for useful data.
Command, we have friendlies assisting. Or at least friendly enough they're not shooting at us.
Friendly took down the target!
Our visitor got the last hit on that target.
Get that position logged so we can scan it later, I want to know what our friend was using on that target.
Lets not do experiements on my hull today.
You better write down the result of that test before I conduct another one.
Another test shot? Really?
Seriously, who authorized that shot? Friendly or neutral fire struck our hull.
Break formation!
Sensors show more incoming fire! Get to stations!
Incoming fire detected! Take evasive action!
Full power to weapons, engage the enemy!
Hull integrity has fallen to a critical level!
Can't take many more shots to that manifold!
Systems failing, hull integrity critical!
Not going to be able to hold this ship together for much longer!
Bifrost drive is taking serious damage, we might not make it out of here!
For Valhalla!
Engines failing, we're going down!
Brace for impact!
The vessel is going down under fire!
I'll see you in Valhalla!
Thruster compromised! Bugging out!
Bifrost drive compromised! Evacuating!
Charge up the Bifrost drive! We need to get out of here!
Hull compromised! Initiating emergency protocols!
Oh no, not letting them get this ship!
Spin up the Bifrost drive, time to leave.
Notations complete, preparing for departure.
All targets scanned, time to jump.
Spin down the drive, preparing for landing.
Clear the pad, else I'm going to squish you!
Tower, we are on approach to land.
Tower, waving off!
Pull up!
Friendly vessel coming along side.
Safe those weapons but stay alert for any sudden movements.
Maintain a cautious distance from the neutral vessel.
Keep an eye on the neutral vessel; its intentions are unclear.
All clear, get back to scanning!
Clear scans, returning to course.
All clear here.
Good to hear, returning to mission.
All good received, good luck out there!
Launch the buoy for the distress signal! We're not going to be able to handle this one on our own!
Mayday! Mayday! We are under attack and requesting ODIN assistance!
Requesting assistance from ODIN forces, we are under attack!
Declaring an Emergency! Requesting immediate ODIN assistance!
Message received, deploy the response team!
Raven's message received, alter course to assist!
ODIN command acknowledged the distress signal; response team en route!
Distress signal confirmed; coordinating with nearby units for immediate response.
All units, be advised: distress signal received. Prepare for engagement.
We didn't make it in time, return to mission.
Resume our search for Valhalla, so we can see our Kin again.
Watch for escape pods, we may need to assist survivors.
More power to engines! We can't let them down!
Charge up the bifrost drive, maybe we can get there in time!
